messages:
bob_customer: Hi — after rotating our production key yesterday we started seeing intermittent 401s (invalid_api_key). Small requests succeed but larger requests (roughly >12KB payload) fail. Only happens from our prod host behind the LB. Example curl and response below.

alice_support: Thanks — can you paste the exact curl you used and the full response headers? Also which key ID are you using? @charlie_infra might have seen header-length issues before :thinking_face:

bob_customer: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_4f3b...FULLKEY...9a2" --data-binary @payload.json https://api.redwood.inference/v1/chat
```

Response:```
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
< content-type: application/json
< x-request-id: abc123
{"error":{"type":"invalid_api_key","message":"The API key in the Authorization header was not recognized."}}
```

alice_support: Can you try a curl that bypasses your LB/proxy (e.g. curl --resolve to the upstream IP) from the same host? Also, can you log what your app sees in $http_authorization / request headers so we can compare?

bob_customer: Ran direct to upstream IP (bypassed nginx) — request succeeds. Logged incoming header on the backend and it looks truncated for the failing requests: ```[INFO] auth header: "Bearer sk_live_4f3b8a7c9d..."``` — the tail of the token is missing in the log for the large payload case.

charlie_infra: Sounds like the proxy is chopping the Authorization header when the request uses chunked transfer or large headers. Which proxy and version? Nginx/haproxy?

bob_customer: nginx 1.18, default buffer settings. Config uses `proxy_buffering on` and `proxy_buffer_size 4k`. We forward the header with `proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;`.

charlie_infra: Nginx can split long headers across buffers (`proxy_buffer_size`, `large_client_header_buffers`) and some upstream setups don't reassemble them the way you expect, resulting in a truncated Authorization value reaching the app. Two quick fixes: increase `proxy_buffer_size` and `large_client_header_buffers`, or avoid splitting by disabling buffer splitting for proxied requests. Can you try bumping `proxy_buffer_size 16k;` and `large_client_header_buffers 4 16k;` and reload?

bob_customer: Applied config changes and reloaded nginx in prod, rolled back a few unhealthy workers, then retried the same ~20KB payload — now it succeeds (no 401). Verified with logs: `auth header: "Bearer sk_live_4f3b8a7c9d...FULLTAIL...9a2"`. :tada:

deploy-bot: nginx config updated in prod at 2026-03-17T14:12:00Z by bob_customer

alice_support: Great, thanks for validating. Root cause: proxy buffer size/config caused Authorization header to be split/truncated on large/chunked requests, upstream treated the token as invalid. Filing KB note and advising customers to increase nginx `proxy_buffer_size`/`large_client_header_buffers` or avoid header splitting for long authorization tokens. Closing once you confirm no further regressions.

bob_customer: Confirmed stable for 24h, closing from our side. Thanks for the help! :white_check_mark:
